9831536d3d1ce649.company_name: Power Equipment And Materials Industrial Factory Co. (PEMCO)
9831536d3d1ce649.description: About Georg Fischer Georg Fischer is seeking a Sales Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for driving sales and market presence within the infrastructure piping systems segment. Role Overview The Sales Engineer will be responsible for conducting all necessary sales activities to achieve sales and gross margin targets for the assigned market segment. This includes managing business with distributors and direct sales, as well as overseeing cash and accounts receivable collection. The role focuses on market screening, customer development, and promoting the company's full product portfolio. Key Responsibilities Conduct sales activities to meet sales and gross margin targets for the market segment. Manage business with distributors and direct sales, including cash and accounts receivable collection. Screen the market and develop relationships with customers, end-users, contractors, EPCs, and O&M providers. Visit potential and existing customers to identify needs, gather project information, and present GF Infrastructure Piping Systems solutions. Identify projects and business opportunities to fuel the sales pipeline. Promote the full product portfolio and service offer using segment strategy to increase awareness and demand, ensuring value selling. Evaluate projects, enquiries, and tenders according to company strategy and targets, managing the quotation process and follow-up. Implement and monitor the sales growth plan and AR for the Infrastructure segment, initiating actions for deviations. Achieve a balanced turnover split with new segments such as Repair fittings, Gas applications, and Manholes to reduce dependency on specific product ranges. Collect innovation ideas for products and services, reviewing potential with internal stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or technical/engineering background preferred. Minimum of 10 years of business experience, including at least 6 years in multi-channel sales, sales management, or marketing within infrastructure market segments. Minimum of 8 years of experience in the relevant country. Proven leadership experience in managing teams and successfully implementing go-to-market strategies. Required Skills Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills. Fluency in both English and Arabic is required. Self-motivated, results-driven, and well-organised, with the ability to work independently and manage priorities. Proficiency in MS Office and CRM applications. Willingness to travel domestically. Strong commitment to business ethics and compliance. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates in a multicultural environment. The position requires domestic travel and adherence to GF Performance Development Processes, including coaching and developing direct reports if applicable.

983ea6a0eb142886.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أسواق زاد البلد التجارية عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات شاملة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء بشكل فعال. توفير معلومات دقيقة ومفصلة للعملاء حول المنتجات، استخداماتها، وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وتخزينها. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة ولباقة في التعامل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

985529489e5bfb5a.description: About the Role JX Executive is seeking an HSE RSPP certified professional with Modules A-B-C for an international project involving a new Plant for a B2B Client in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time role for an individual with 5-10 years of experience, offering a salary of GAS+MBO 100-120K€. Role Context and Objectives The ideal candidate will come from a structured environment, with an orientation towards World Class Manufacturing (WCM), Lean Manufacturing, and Continuous Improvement. This role is responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance and the continuous development of Health, Safety & Environment policies. The individual will actively contribute to continuous improvement programs within an advanced industrial context, working in strong integration with Operations, Quality, and Production teams. A key objective is to support the dissemination of a safety culture within Lean and WCM processes. Key Responsibilities Assume the role of RSPP in accordance with Legislative Decree 81/08. Ensure compliance with local and international HSE regulations. Draft and update DVR (Risk Assessment Document), procedures, and technical documentation. Promote a safety culture through training and awareness for personnel. Analyze incidents, near misses, and non-conformities, implementing corrective and preventive actions. Collaborate with Production and Engineering to integrate HSE principles into production processes. Support WCM (World Class Manufacturing) initiatives and continuous improvement programs. Manage internal and external audits (ISO 45001, ISO 14001). Monitor HSE KPIs and develop improvement plans. Coordinate suppliers, consultants, and external bodies on safety and environmental issues. Qualifications and Experience HSE RSPP certification with Modules A-B-C is required. 5-10 years of professional experience in a relevant field. Experience within a structured environment oriented towards WCM, Lean Manufacturing, and Continuous Improvement. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working on an international project for a new Plant. The role requires strong collaboration with Operations, Quality, and Production teams to integrate HSE principles and foster a safety-conscious culture.

98cb8e3af475e02c.description: About the Role stc is seeking a Sales & Account Management Director to lead sales and account management activities within the Business-Critical segment. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on developing sales strategies, managing key client relationships, and driving revenue growth. The role involves overseeing sales performance, managing pipelines, and ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead the development of the Business-Critical sales strategy and detailed account sales plans. Drive lead generation and engagement with prospective beneficiaries through networking, business development activities, and industry events, in coordination with Marketing and Communications. Lead consultative sales approaches to understand client needs and ensure the delivery of tailored solutions. Oversee the development of upselling and cross-selling approaches to expand existing accounts. Monitor sales performance and ensure the identification and capture of cross- and up-selling opportunities. Lead negotiation of commercial terms, including discounts and bulk deals, in alignment with Finance and Product Development guidelines. Manage complex negotiations to ensure mutually beneficial agreements, in coordination with the Legal team. Drive the positioning and showcasing of Business-Critical offerings and identify incremental business opportunities with enterprise customers. Ensure the development and maintenance of a healthy sales pipeline to support continuous business growth. Monitor pipeline KPIs and ensure corrective actions are taken to meet or exceed revenue targets. Build and maintain relationships with beneficiaries and key stakeholders, including engagement at the C-suite level, ensuring high customer satisfaction. Oversee account management activities, ensuring effective contract management and timely renewals. Ensure alignment with Business Operations for timely delivery of solutions according to agreed designs and timelines. Provide sales demand inputs to support annual forecasting and budgeting processes, in coordination with Business Operations and Finance. Provide inputs on sales performance to Product Development & Management and support product/service enhancements aligned with customer demand. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 7-10 years of relevant experience in sales and account management, particularly within a business-critical segment. The position requires a proven track record in developing and executing sales strategies, managing client relationships, and driving revenue growth. Skills and Competencies Strong leadership abilities to guide sales and account management teams. Proficiency in strategic planning and execution of sales initiatives. Excellent negotiation and communication skills, including C-suite engagement. Ability to manage complex sales pipelines and monitor performance against targets. Strong understanding of customer requirements and tailored solution delivery. Capability to collaborate effectively with internal departments such as Marketing, Finance, Product Development, and Legal. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring a commitment to achieving sales objectives and maintaining high customer satisfaction within a dynamic business environment.

985976aa11710095.company_name: H. M. Al Rugaib & Sons Trading Co.
985976aa11710095.description: About the Role H. M. Al Rugaib & Sons Trading is seeking a Sales Associate to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for delivering excellent customer service, understanding customer needs, and recommending suitable furniture products to achieve sales targets. The Sales Associate plays a key role in ensuring a positive shopping experience for all customers. Key Responsibilities Welcome customers and assist them in selecting appropriate furniture and home furnishing products. Understand customer needs and recommend products based on their preferences, requirements, and budget. Provide accurate information regarding product features, materials, specifications, prices, and promotions. Achieve individual and showroom sales targets. Build and maintain strong customer relationships to encourage repeat business. Follow up with customers concerning quotations, orders, and product inquiries. This role is suitable for individuals looking to develop their skills in sales and customer service within the furniture retail sector. 9880e7d743bcdf2a.description: About HungerStation HungerStation, a part of the Delivery Hero Group, is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Delivery Hero is a global delivery platform operating in approximately 65 countries, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, and listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017. This contract position is for an individual contributor who can also support a team and collaborate with management on strategic initiatives. Role Overview The Senior Backend Engineer will contribute to the architectural decisions for a platform used by millions. This role involves active participation in the migration of a monolithic application to microservices and playing a key part in designing, improving, and securing the backend architecture to support significant growth in users and products. Key Responsibilities Participate in architectural decision-making for a high-traffic platform. Actively contribute to the migration from a monolithic application to microservices. Design, improve, and secure the overall backend architecture to support user and product growth. Work with Docker containers, Kubernetes manifests, and Google Cloud Platform. Coach and mentor other team members within the Backend Chapter. Apply Design Driven Development, SOLID Principles, Event-driven Architecture, Algorithms, and automated tests (unit, integration, functional). Understand the development lifecycle and collaborate with cross-functional and agile teams. Contribute to test coverage, refactoring, and documentation efforts. Perform code reviews, debugging, and investigations regularly. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in backend engineering. Demonstrated track record as a significant individual contributor. Strong team player capabilities. Ability to work closely with management to advance strategic initiatives. Professional Development HungerStation supports continuous learning and development. Employees have opportunities to exchange ideas with over 2000 colleagues from various teams within Delivery Hero through active guilds and a global tech and product community. A personal educational budget is provided for conferences and external training. Access to the LinkedIn e-learning platform and various in-house training programs are also available.

98d1279823a30fc1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سوبريم الخليج لتقنية المعلومات عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ وتقييم السياسات التسويقية للسلع والخدمات، مع التركيز على تحليل السوق وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد عوامل نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات التسعير المناسبة. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف وتطوير السياسات التسويقية. مهارات في إجراء اختبارات السوق وتحليل البيانات. إتقان إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل في شركة سوبريم الخليج لتقنية المعلومات، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا كأخصائي تسويق، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

9865ccea74fdd180.job_title: Associate Director, Built Environment & Infrastructure Design Consulting
9865ccea74fdd180.description: Thanks to continued growth, we are now looking for an Associate Director to join our Built Environment and Infrastructure team in Riyadh. As the Associate Director you will manage security design consulting engagements to a professional standard; independently and in support of other senior colleagues, and the Principal. You will serve as a Subject Matter Expert of electronic and physical security systems and manage security design and installation projects from conception to completion. You will maintain client and company deliverables, ensuring that high quality is maintained, and the client and company budgets and programs are met and maintained. You will also develop and build new and existing client relationships, facilitating where appropriate the introduction and provision of additional Control Risks services. Role tasks and responsibilities Support the Principal with the leadership of the team and generate new business across the region by supporting key business development activities. Undertaking fee earning consultancy, including but not limited to the assessment of risk, definition of security strategies and high-level planning, concept and detailed master planning. Concept and detailed technical design including the development of performance specifications and design guidance notes. Assisting, and designing for our engagements, including technical security reviews, audits, design surveys, installation inspections and approvals, working at client sites and in the office. Designing physical and electronic security systems to an appropriate level, working in conjunction with specialist engineers from other organisations within project design teams. As a trusted advisor ensure requests from clients and prospects are dealt with effectively to develop client relationships across the full breadth of capabilities. Creating proposals and building project budgets to define scope and determine pricing prior to sign-off by designated managers. Maintaining accurate financial forecasting, project planning, resource planning, and financial reporting. Operational planning and management of engagements, including quality oversight of operational and document-based deliverables and compliance with Control Risks policies, standards and methodologies. Operational responsibility for and collaborative input into performance management of team members. Adopt innovative approaches to development of current practices and new solutions and act as a thought leader and coordinate with peer group across the business. Knowledge and understanding of the CPTED principles and other leading initiatives including Secured by Design and recognised safety and security planning guidance. Understanding and experience of delivering physical and electronic security design consulting across RIBA Plan of Work stages. Proven ability of operating successfully at a senior level, implementing policy, driving quality and growing a business. Proven experience of delivering consultancy-based engagements. Proven experience of people management. Proven experience of successful budgeting, project management and project closure. Membership of a security or design engineering related institute. Excellent writing and presentation skills with proven ability to participate in speaking engagements. Ability to liaise with and build successful client relationships. Ability to quickly assimilate large quantities of new information. Bachelor’s degree or advanced diploma in risk management, design or related security, crisis and/or business continuity fields. Security related professional certification. Knowledge of, and experience using design-related software, e.g. AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, MS Project and other relevant software experience. Control Risks offers a competitively positioned compensation and benefits package that is transparent and summarised in the full job offer. We operate a discretionary global bonus scheme that incentivises, and rewards individuals based on company and individual performance. Control Risks supports hybrid working arrangements, wherever possible, that emphasise the value of in-person time together - in the office and with our clients - while continuing to support flexible and remote working. As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join us and are fully committed to equal treatment, free from discrimination, of all candidates throughout our recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments to be made in order to participate fully in the interview process, please let us know and we will be happy to accommodate your needs.

9810b43242e806df.description: About the Role Novartis Saudi Arabia is seeking a Sales Representative-CRM to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position is suitable for a pharmacist with 0-1 years of experience who is driven to make a difference for patients by connecting them with innovative treatments. Role Overview The Sales Representative will serve as a trusted partner to healthcare professionals within their assigned territory. This role involves leveraging data-driven insights and engaging in value-based conversations to cultivate lasting relationships, deliver impactful customer experiences, and contribute to competitive sales growth. Key Responsibilities Achieve or surpass territory sales and market-share objectives within established budgets and timelines. Identify and prioritize high-potential healthcare professionals and stakeholders using data and customer insights. Develop trusted, long-term relationships with key opinion leaders, medical influencers, and healthcare professionals. Lead value-based conversations, both in-person and virtually, to understand customer needs, decision drivers, challenges, and opportunities. Personalize and orchestrate customer journeys across relevant channels, utilizing approved content and customer preferences. Collaborate with healthcare professionals to enhance the patient journey and ensure patients receive appropriate support at the right time. Meet agreed targets for contact, coverage, frequency, and customer engagement. Qualifications and Experience Pharmacist qualification. 0-1 years of relevant experience. 9845b809cfba6feb.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Kitchen & Laundry Technician to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for maintaining and repairing kitchen and laundry equipment, ensuring operational efficiency and guest satisfaction. The role requires 0-1 years of experience in a related field. Key Responsibilities Respond to and address guest repair requests promptly, communicating effectively to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and equipment in kitchen and mechanical rooms, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, and machinery for proper function. Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate daily activities and problems to other shifts using approved communication programs. Perform surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, and light bulb and A/C filter replacement. Test, troubleshoot, and perform basic repairs on various equipment, plumbing (*, unclogging drains), and electrical components. Program TVs and assist with general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory tasks. Utilize the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Execute repairs on interior and exterior landscaping, including external landscaping sprinklers. Technical Skills and Knowledge Basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, and plumbing systems. Familiarity with pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry, and finish skills. Understanding of kitchen equipment, energy conservation, and general building maintenance. Basic computer skills, including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes. Workplace Conduct and Safety Adhere to all company and safety and security policies and procedures. Report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries. Complete required safety training and certifications. Properly store flammable materials. Maintain a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Capable of moving up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Teamwork and Guest Service Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support team goals. Communicate clearly and professionally with others.

98727b9540e0c063.description: About the Role Cornerstone Global Partners (CGP Group) is seeking a Senior Recruitment Manager PMC Saudi National for a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves leading talent acquisition across the MENA region for a multinational Project Management Consultancy (PMC) firm, with a primary focus on Saudi Arabia. The firm specializes in delivering large-scale land, infrastructure, and building projects for major government and Public Investment Fund (PIF) entities. Strong background in hiring for engineering consultancy, PMC/PMCM, construction, or infrastructure sectors. Established professional network within the Saudi market. 98d6e109cca42fab.description: About the Role flyadeal is seeking a Manager Service Excellence & Training to lead the development and delivery of service training programs for cabin crew. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on shaping customer service, handling service concerns, and enhancing onboard sales capabilities. Role Purpose The Manager Service Excellence & Training will establish onboard service standards and translate them into practical training modules for cabin crew at all career stages. The role also involves developing cabin leaders who can effectively coach their teams to deliver a consistent customer experience across the network. Key Responsibilities Develop onboard service standards and practical guides for cabin crew application on flights. Lead the design and delivery of initial, recurrent, upgrade, and refresher service training, including coordination for wet-lease and third-party crew. Identify training needs using customer feedback, Net Promoter Score (NPS) results, service audits, and flight reports. Implement blended learning approaches (instructor-led and digital) to improve customer engagement, emotional intelligence, and service recovery. Collaborate with Commercial and Inflight Services to develop onboard sales training that builds product knowledge, supports product recommendations, and ensures confident use of point-of-sale systems. Develop leadership training for Senior Cabin Crew, Cabin Managers, and service trainers, involving high-performing crew members in peer coaching. Maintain up-to-date training materials and audit-ready records in compliance with General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) requirements and company manuals. Coordinate with Safety and Emergency Procedures, Crew Resource Management, and Human Factors training teams for consistent guidance. Measure the impact of training on service quality and onboard sales, using findings to refine programs. Qualifications and Experience At least 8 years of aviation experience, with a minimum of 3 years leading cabin crew service training programs. Experience in onboard sales or retail training. Strong understanding of cabin crew operations, onboard service standards, and service recovery processes. Required Skills Ability to assess training needs, design and deliver learning programs, and evaluate their impact on performance. Strong communication, coaching, and project management skills. Demonstrated ability to develop cabin leaders and collaborate effectively across operational and commercial teams. Application Process Candidates with 5-10 years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

98d8887221a04280.description: About the Role Vanderlande is seeking a Maintenance Planner to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Province. This full-time position involves coordinating and monitoring maintenance activities to ensure operational efficiency and accurate record-keeping. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor the status of PM, CM, and EM work orders within SAP, DOS MAXIMO, or the designated CMMS. Ensure work orders are properly assigned, scheduled, updated, and closed with complete technical documentation. Follow up on overdue work orders and pending approvals. Verify that maintenance records accurately reflect work performed and that delays are properly documented. Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure accurate maintenance history and equipment records. Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, man-hours, work order status, and equipment downtime as required. Extract SAP reports for PM compliance, outstanding work orders, backlog, and maintenance history. Prepare Excel reports and update maintenance trackers. Reconcile SAP data with approved maintenance reports and source documents. Maintain traceable documentation for audits and management reporting. Collaborate closely with the maintenance engineer, maintenance manager, and team leaders. Organize all required materials, tools, permits, and competencies necessary to execute service activities at customer sites. Required Experience and Skills 2-5 years of experience in maintenance planning or a related field. Proficiency in using CMMS systems such as SAP or DOS MAXIMO. Strong organizational skills with attention to detail for documentation and record-keeping. Ability to prepare and analyze reports using SAP and Excel. Effective communication and coordination skills for working with various teams. Work Environment This position offers an opportunity to contribute to industry-leading projects within an international and professional working environment. The role involves collaboration with dedicated colleagues and customers, providing avenues for personal and professional development.

9880112147211132.description: About Egis Egis is an international firm specializing in architecture, consulting, construction engineering, and mobility services. The company focuses on developing and operating intelligent infrastructures and buildings that address climate challenges and contribute to sustainable territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis leverages the expertise of its 19,500 employees to deliver innovative solutions across various projects. In the Middle East, Egis employs 3,500 professionals across 8 countries, having successfully delivered over 700 complex development projects. The firm is recognized among the top ten in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR) and is committed to sustainable development. Egis maintains a strong presence in the region through strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions, serving as a trusted partner for governments, investors, and developers with comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services. The Role Egis (KSA) is seeking a Senior Cost Engineer to join their team in Tabuk (Neom, Tabuk). This is a contract position requiring extensive experience in cost management within construction and engineering projects. The Senior Cost Engineer will be responsible for managing all aspects of project costs, from initial planning and estimation to final account settlement, ensuring financial control and efficiency throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Prepare cost plans, estimates, and Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and maintain project budgets. Monitor costs against budget, produce regular cost reports, and generate cash flow forecasts. Measure completed works and review and certify interim payment applications. Assess variations and claims, providing advice on entitlement, valuation, and contractual positions. Support tendering, procurement processes, and bid evaluations. Administer commercial aspects of FIDIC-based contracts. Prepare and agree upon final accounts. Identify cost-saving opportunities through value engineering initiatives. Collaborate closely with the project team, contractors, and client representatives. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in cost engineering or a related field. Demonstrated experience in preparing cost plans, estimates, and BOQs. Proficiency in monitoring costs, producing reports, and forecasting cash flow. Experience with FIDIC-based contracts and commercial administration. Ability to assess variations and claims effectively. Strong analytical skills for identifying value engineering opportunities. Work Type This is a contract position based in Tabuk, specifically covering projects in Neom and Tabuk. The role requires active engagement with project teams and external stakeholders.

9806464004a2b68c.description: About the Role Emdad By Elm is seeking a Technical Committee Secretary to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves performing technical activities related to Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and site and real estate assessments. The position requires reviewing and analyzing plans, boundaries, coordinates, aerial imagery, and spatial data to ensure compliance with approved documents and regulatory plans, thereby supporting the accuracy of technical studies and informed decision-making. Key Responsibilities Review and examine site boundaries, including property shape, dimensions, and compliance with aerial imagery and existing orders. Approve boundaries or refer them to the engineering supervisor for specific action. Apply property boundaries to spatial layers, such as expropriation areas, registered properties, state-owned assets, and plans, and verify the type and percentage of overlap. Conduct spatial analyses, including distance calculations, facility routes, coordinate conversion, and mapping of remaining areas outside expropriation zones. Verify the consistency of boundaries, lengths, and adjacent properties stated in documents with field surveys and actual site conditions, and compare the site with previous boundaries and studies. Verify whether the site conflicts with approved regulatory plans and streets. Analyze aerial imagery prior to and after the reference date 09/11/1387 AH to determine the status and history of land development. Request updated imagery when quality is insufficient or required. Review updates to spatial layers and expropriation areas received from relevant authorities, assess their impact on cases under study, and submit them for approval. Support reconsideration requests submitted by government entities and follow up until a response is received. Prepare technical study results in accordance with approved standards and generate required technical reports for relevant authorities, including details on expropriation areas and aerial imagery. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Proficiency in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and spatial data analysis. 989a86e2cd300a00.description: We’re looking for a Customer Experience Manager - Strategy & Operations to take ownership of the end-to-end customer experience for a fast-growing B2B spend-management platform serving finance teams across Saudi Arabia. You’ll be responsible for making sure every customer interaction, from support tickets and calls to escalations and self-serve resources, is smooth, efficient, and consistently high-quality. You’ll own the key CX metrics, improve SLAs, and turn customer feedback and recurring issues into meaningful improvements. This is an operator role, not a pure people-management role. You’ll be hands-on with dashboards, processes, reporting, and root-cause analysis, while working closely with Product and Engineering to improve the customer experience and build smarter, more scalable support operations. You will own and manage the CX team and department end-to-end. This role doesn’t require a traditional CX background. We’re looking for someone with strong problem-solving instincts, a data-driven mindset, and the drive to build and own processes from the ground up. If you’ve come from consulting or a fast-paced operational role and you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and operate, we want to hear from you. Responsibilties Own day-to-day support operations across ticketing, phone, and in-app channels; manage queue health, routing, and coverage. Lead, coach, and schedule the support team; run QA on ticket and call quality with a documented scorecard. Own the Support SLA & Escalation Matrix: first response, resolution, and escalation paths across L1/L2/L3 and third-party processors. Track and drive the core CX metrics: first-response and resolution SLA attainment, call abandonment, callback compliance, awaiting-customer rate, reopened-ticket rate, CSAT. Build and maintain reporting in Zoho Desk/Zoho Analytics; publish a weekly operations review with findings and actions, not just numbers. Own the knowledge base, customer-facing and internal, including release-triggered updates and the content feeding the AI call agent. Identify recurring ticket drivers and convert them into product fixes, automations, or self-serve content; work with Engineering and Product to close them. Actively look for manual workflows to automate and standardize, macros, auto-assignment, classification, and workflow integrations. Ensure complaint handling meets SAMA requirements, including complaint logging, response timelines, and escalation/disclosure obligations. Manage escalations end-to-end, including card, transaction, and processor-side issues requiring third-party coordination. Act as the internal voice of the customer, surface patterns, flag issues early, and drive cross-functional accountability for experience quality. Strong problem-solving skills with a track record of diagnosing issues, finding root causes, and implementing fixes, not just managing symptoms. Data-driven approach: comfortable building dashboards, interrogating numbers, and making recommendations backed by data. SQL or Power BI experience is a plus. High agency, takes full ownership, moves fast, and doesn’t wait to be told where to focus. Automation mindset, actively identifies processes to automate and standardize, and has done so in a previous role.
